name: New Yotia
description: The first city of the green west, a wooden river city on a mesa above the Mardun where Kayla settles for a time.

description_citations.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla reaches New Yotia, lingers there, and resolves to cross the continent to learn the truth about Harbin.
timeline.quote: Kayla resolved to cross the continent to learn the truth.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Kayla secretly displays her magic by snuffing and relighting the lamps.
timeline.quote: As one, the oil lamps Kayla had left burning snuffed out, then reignited.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Jarsyl tells Kayla he cannot go with her because he wants to join a school of magic and artifice run by Nod and Duck, and Kayla blesses it.
timeline.quote: Go north. If there are teachers greater than me, seek them out.

citation.work: The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning
citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Episode 2: The Beginning" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: After the war New Yotia rises on the Mardun; the kingdom is later absorbed into Argive.
